body.statement: Kennedy's Gaussian-process and multiplier-bootstrap results for incremental propensity-score effects index the odds multiplier by a fixed compact set; those results do not cover a sequence of multipliers \(\delta_n\to\infty\).

source.locator: Corollary 2 and the fixed compact multiplier index set used for the Gaussian process and multiplier bootstrap
